work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLXIV appoints Eugène de Rumilly minister general of the Capuchins (Spain excepted) with procurator and definitors for six years; LF37175 → LF37182 across own provenance LF37178 and running title LF37181; LF37246 → LF37250 across page number 253 LF37249; complete 16 March 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF37130–37130; the source closing at LF37294–37297 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima sexta martii mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, pontifi- catus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
